note:
Services in addons/stock/static/src returning an object literal from start() instead of an instance. Fourth tree onboarded to js_service_shape.py, after web, mail and account.

Zero — but only after two changes, and the order matters. stock has exactly one service, stock_warehouse, and it was registered by passing an object literal straight to .add(). The ANALYZER could not see that form at all: it resolved a service only through a named binding (VariableDeclarator -> ObjectExpression), so an inline registration was skipped before its shape was ever examined. stock_warehouse's start() returned { destroy() {...} } — precisely the shape this gate faults — and the gate read 0 for the tree. Onboarding first would have committed a floor of 0 that checked nothing, which is the decorative-gate failure mode tooling/typecheck/README.md argues against.

So js_service_shape.mjs now collects both registration forms, and stock_warehouse returns a StockWarehouseService instance. Repo-wide only three services used the inline form (website's google_maps, mass_mailing's themes, stock's) and NONE of them are in a gated scope, so the fix moved no committed floor: web 13, mail 5, account 0, all re-measured unchanged. It did surface one previously invisible offender in website (google_maps), which is ungated and therefore uncounted.

Command: python tooling/architecture/js_service_shape.py --addon stock --count
